name: Chimes: ring the bells in the order heard
notes: Reference puzzle for sound (mw-e15.10), built with data only: a button and a hidden chime source (the sound clue node), three impact-switch bells against the far wall of a pit, a bell sequence node (high, low, mid) and a crate to throw. The goal is the outcome (the sequence latch is set), so any strike counts: a crate lobbed or carried over the pit, an arrow. Declared: listen then lob the crate; listen then carry the crate over with Mage Hand and drop it on the bells (sorcerer); and the order known without listening, written in a keeper's ledger (`by-the-book`). That last route is modelled as skipping the button: no readable item exists in the scene because a lore book needs cover art and legal data this bead may not add, and the book reader is not wired (see the follow-up bead), so the `clue.<item>` trail is not exercised here (mw-e15.32, mw-e15.25). Shooting the bells from a balcony is not declared: the validator cannot model an arrow (mw-e15.31) (a `contact` stimulus is never an impact), so it would be unvalidated; the arrow feed rings the same bells, and the tests strike them as an arrow does. Greybox, not story canon.
